city.none: No town found. Try another spelling.
city.offline: No internet right now. Try again later.
city.onlyTown: Only the name of the town, please. No street or address.
consent.body: To show the weather, the app asks Open-Meteo for the forecast for your town. Open-Meteo is a free weather service. It receives the town and, like any website, this device's internet (IP) address. Nothing else about your child is sent. If you say no, the app works offline and asks "What's it like outside?" instead.
consent.no: No, we will tell it ourselves
consent.title: Weather lookups
extra.hood: Hood or hat for the wind
extra.layers: Layers you can take off later
gate.body: Please ask a grown-up to answer this.
gate.locked: Too many tries. Please wait 30 seconds.
gate.question: What is {a} × {b}?
gate.title: For grown-ups
gate.wrong: Not quite. Here is a new question.
item.colorsHint: Pick up to 3, main colour first.
item.name: {color} {kind}
item.saveFailed: This could not be saved. The storage may be full: remove some photos and try again.
item.title: Clothes
me.learnedCold: You get cold easily, so I pick warmer clothes.
me.learnedNothing: Rate a few outfits and I will learn what you like.
me.learnedWarm: You get warm easily, so I pick lighter clothes.
onboarding.cityHint: Just your town, so I can check the weather. A grown-up can change it later.
onboarding.nicknameHint: A nickname is perfect. No real names needed.
onboarding.noWeather: Weather lookups are off, so no town is needed. Each morning you just tap what it is like outside.
onboarding.parentBody1: Wardrobe Buddy suggests outfits from her own clothes, based on the weather and her mood.
onboarding.parentBody2: Profile, clothes and ratings stay on this device: no account, no ads, no tracking. Next you choose whether the app may look up the weather.
onboarding.parentBody3: Please set it up together. Answer the question below to continue.
onboarding.skipHint: You can fill this in later in Me.
parent.aboutBody: Wardrobe Buddy is free and non-profit. No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts.
parent.dataBody: Profile, wardrobe, photos and ratings are stored only on this device (on the web: in this browser). They are not backed up to the cloud. Uninstalling the app removes them; on the web, clear this site's data in the browser.
parent.deleteConfirm: This deletes the profile, wardrobe and ratings on this device. It cannot be undone.
parent.exportNote: On a phone the file has the data but not the photos. On the web the file includes the photos (selfies are blurred). Keep it private.
parent.learningReset: Done. The app starts learning from scratch.
parent.privacyBody: The only internet requests are weather lookups (if allowed above): the town and the device's internet address go to Open-Meteo. No name, age or photos are ever sent.
parent.resetLearning: Reset what the app has learned
parent.title: Grown-up settings
photo.clothesOnly: Take photos of clothes only, not people. Lay it flat or hang it up.
photo.colorsGuessed: I guessed the colours from the photo. Change them if they are wrong.
photo.denied: No camera, no problem: choose a photo instead, or skip it.
photo.deniedForever: The camera is turned off for this app. A grown-up can turn it on in the phone's settings.
photo.failed: That photo did not work. Try another one.
photo.introBody: Your phone will ask if Wardrobe Buddy may use the camera. The photos stay on this phone and are never sent anywhere. You can say no and still pick a photo or skip it.
photo.title: Photo
rate.question: How did your outfit feel today?
rate.title: How was it?
selfie.a11y: Your photo, with your face blurred
selfie.blurred: Your face is blurred to keep you private.
selfie.explain: If you like, use a photo of yourself instead of the avatar. Your face is always blurred, and the photo stays on this device. The phone may ask if the app can use the camera.
selfie.onlyYou: Only photos of yourself, no friends or family.
selfie.title: Or use a photo of yourself
tip.addLighterClothes: It is warm today. Add some lighter clothes, like a T-shirt or shorts.
tip.addOuterwear: Add a jacket so I can keep you warm on chilly days. 🧥
tip.addRainJacket: Add a rain jacket so I can keep you dry on rainy days. ☔
tip.addShoes: Add your shoes so the outfit is complete. 👟
tip.addTopsAndBottoms: Add a top and some bottoms (or a dress) so I can make an outfit.
tip.addWarmerClothes: Brrr! Add some warmer clothes, like a jumper or a big coat.
tip.allInLaundry: Everything is in the wash! Mark a few things as clean in Wardrobe.
tip.emptyWardrobe: Add your first clothes and I can start picking outfits for you. 👕
tip.needWeather: Tell me what it's like outside, and I'll pick your outfit.
wardrobe.emptyBody: Start with 5 things you wear a lot.
wardrobe.photoTip: Tip: only the clothes go in here, not people.
wardrobe.title: My clothes
weather.noCity: Weather lookups are off or no town is set. A grown-up can change this in settings ⚙️.
weather.offline: I can't reach the weather right now.
week.noCity: A grown-up can add your town in settings ⚙️ to plan the week.
week.noForecast: I need the forecast to plan the week. Try again when you are online.
week.subtitle: I mix it up so you are not wearing the same thing twice in a row.
week.tapHint: Shows why and what to remember
week.title: This week
